name: Cooler
skill:
[auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[br]
[auto] If you have 2 or more energy: When you activate a blue Extra from your hand, draw 2 cards, add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left, then flip this card to its back side.
[br]
[activate: main] Add up to 1 {Yes, Time to Die!} from your deck to your hand, shuffle your deck, and negate this skill for the game.
[br]
[awaken] When your life is at5 or less: Draw 2 cards.

back.name: Cooler, Incredible Strongest Warrior
back.skill:
[auto][once per turn] When a blue ≪Cooler's Armored Squadron≫ card or blue Extra is returned from your Battle Area to its owner's hand, you may play 1 blue ≪Cooler's Armored Squadron≫ card with an energy cost of 5 from your energy. If you do, add 1 card from your hand to your energy in Rest Mode.
[br]
[activate: battle][once per turn] Choose up to 1 blue ≪Cooler's Armored Squadron≫ card that's not in a battle or up to 1 blue Extra in your Battle Area and return it to its owner's hand.

name: Salza, Technique
skill:
[counter: attack] Negate the attack and play this card.
[auto] If it's your turn: When this card is played, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 blue <Cooler> card, blue ≪Cooler's Armored Squadron≫ card, or blue Extra with an energy cost of 0 to your hand, then shuffle your deck.

name: Neiz, Elite Squad Splendor
skill:
[Blocker]
[Auto][Limit 1] When this card is played, draw 1 card, and this card gains [Barrier] until the end of your opponent's turn.

name: Yes, Time to Die!
skill:
[activate: main/battle][limit 1] If your Leader is blue: Until the end of your opponent's turn, if your opponent's Battle Card would be returned to its owner's hand by a skill on your card, place it at the bottom of its owner's deck instead.
[activate: main][limit 1]{u}, if your Leader is a blue <Cooler> card, you choose 1 blue Extra in your Battle Area, and return it to its owner's hand: Add this card in your Drop to your hand.

name: Unrelenting Assault Trunks
skill:
[Over Realm 3] (If you have at least 3 cards in your Drop Area, you can play this card by sending all cards in your Drop Area to your Warp. At the end of that turn, send this card from the Battle Area to your Warp. [Over Realm] can be activated once per turn)
[Auto] When this card is sent to the Warp from your Battle Area or deck, add it to your hand.

name: Hidden Power Great Ape Fasha
skill:

[Auto] When a card evolves into this card, choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards and switch them to Rest Mode.
